subject: VM evidence index for SIG review and remediation attestations
messages:
From: Darren Quinn <d.quinn@clientcorp.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: security@clientcorp.com
Date: Fri, 14 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG: VM scan cadence + attestation for SOC2 pack

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

As part of ClientCorp's SIG intake for our SOC 2 refresh, our security team needs a concise package showing:
- scan cadence and tooling used (SCA/agent/agentless)
- SLA for critical (P1/P2) CVE remediation and any documented exceptions
- a signed attestation stating Redwood's current average time-to-fix for P1/P2 over the last 12 months
- an index of artifacts (scan exports, ticket IDs, proof of remediation) we can include in our audit bundle

Can you provide those items by EOD 2028-04-14? If you can't make EOD, a clear timeline and point of contact will work for now. We may need an internal RFC if there are exceptions for legacy components.

Thanks,
Darren
Darren Quinn
Security Lead, ClientCorp
security@clientcorp.com

---
Attachment request: Please include a CSV index of scans and a single PDF with remediation attestations if possible.
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Darren Quinn <d.quinn@clientcorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Apr 2028 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG: VM scan cadence + attestation for SOC2 pack

Hi Darren — thanks for the clear list. Short answer: yes, we can deliver a concise package today. 

High-level notes (will be expanded in attachments):
- Scan cadence: weekly authenticated network & host scans (Nessus), daily agent-based vulnerability telemetry (internal agent v2.1), and continuous SCA for container images (Anchore).
- Critical SLA: P1 (active exploit or remote RCE) — 72 hours from detection to remediation plan; P2 (high severity) — 14 days to remediation plan, 30 days to closure target. These SLAs are in our SOC2 playbook.
- Exceptions: a small fraction of legacy air-gapped clusters (0.8%) are on an extended mitigation timeline; documented per-asset exceptions are included in the index.

I'm attaching: vm-scan-index-20280414.csv (index referencing scan exports and ticket IDs) and cve-closure-log-20280414.pdf (signed attestation + summary metrics).

If you need signed hardcopy, Marissa can coordinate with legal. Ben — flag for the renewal team if ClientCorp wants this bundled with their next compliance package.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Head of Security & Trust, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

---
Attachments: vm-scan-index-20280414.csv (CSV, 42KB), cve-closure-log-20280414.pdf (PDF, 18KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Apr 2028 13:20:00 -07:00

Jonas — quick internal note so the response is consistent with sales/renewals expectations.

Jonas wrote: 
> - Exceptions: a small fraction of legacy air-gapped clusters (0.8%) are on an extended mitigation timeline; documented per-asset exceptions are included in the index.

We should call out the following in the external packet:
- The exception list contains 5 assets (asset IDs included in the CSV) with mitigation plans and compensating controls (network segmentation + read-only data flow).
- For audit clarity, include the remediation tickets (JIRA YAML refs) and the compensating-control evidence folder link.
- Offer a 1:1 review with ClientCorp security next week to walk their auditor through the artifacts.

Ben — if ClientCorp asks for timeline concessions or credits tied to the exception assets, we should route to commercial; I'm happy to lead that conversation.

Marissa Cole
Dir, Customer Trust Operations
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Darren Quinn <d.quinn@clientcorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, security@clientcorp.com
Date: Fri, 14 Apr 2028 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG: VM scan cadence + attestation for SOC2 pack

Darren — attaching the finalized package per your ask. Summary below and next steps.

Summary (artifacts attached):
- vm-scan-index-20280414.csv — index mapping scan exports (Nessus JSON), agent telemetry extracts, ticket IDs, and remediation status. The CSV has columns: asset_id, scan_type, scan_date, cve_id, ticket_id, status, mitigation_notes.
- cve-closure-log-20280414.pdf — signed attestation (Jonas Weber, Head of Security & Trust) with 12-month median time-to-plan and time-to-closure metrics for P1/P2.

Key clarifications:
- SLA: P1: 72 hours to remediation plan; P2: 14 days to remediation plan. Closure targets as noted above.
- Exceptions: 5 assets listed (see CSV). All have documented compensating controls and tickets; two of the assets have a planned hardware replacement window in Q3 2028.

Next steps: please confirm receipt. If your auditor prefers a short walkthrough, propose any of these slots next week and we'll set a calendar invite: Mon 4/17 10:00-11:00 PT, Tue 4/18 14:00-15:00 PT, Wed 4/19 09:00-09:30 PT.

Thanks — attaching the files now.

Jonas Weber
Head of Security & Trust, Redwood Inference
